definitions.explanation: A deep, vivid blue color traditionally derived from the mineral lapis lazuli. Widely used in Japanese art, particularly in nihonga (Japanese-style painting). Also used more broadly to describe a rich, deep blue in everyday language.

examples.japanese: {群青|ぐんじょう}⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっていた→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: A deep blue sky stretched out above.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ→夕暮れ：07682_yuugure⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{群青|ぐんじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まって→染まる：04254_somaru⟧いく。
examples.english: The sea at dusk is being dyed in ultramarine blue.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{日本画|にほんが}→日本画：18225_nihonga⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{群青|ぐんじょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{金箔|きんぱく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ふんだん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}われて→使う：00473_tsukau⟧おり、⟦{豪華|ごうか}→豪華：02815_gouka⟧な⟦{印象|いんしょう}→印象：01846_inshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: This Japanese-style painting uses ultramarine blue and gold leaf abundantly, giving a luxurious impression.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in compound form {群青|ぐんじょう}⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ to explicitly mean "ultramarine color." A culturally significant pigment in traditional Japanese painting (⟦{日本画|にほんが}→日本画：18225_nihonga⟧), where it is one of the most prized mineral pigments. Also commonly encountered as an evocative color word in literature and song lyrics.
The Yoasobi song "{群青|ぐんじょう}" (2020) made this word widely known among younger generations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {群青|ぐんじょう}⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: ultramarine blue (as a color name)
- {群青|ぐんじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧: deep blue sky
- {群青|ぐんじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧: deep blue sea
